d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To function as a Commis 2 for Calo Qatar's On-Demand QSR Kitchen. Support the kitchen team by executing daily preparation, cooking, and assembly tasks to meet Calo’s nutritional and speed standards. The successful candidate will play a critical role in maintaining high production efficiency and ensuring every order leaves the kitchen accurately prepared and on time.
Works under the guidance of senior chefs and CDPs in the Section
Works closely with the Kitchen Management, Production Leads to support workflow efficiency and production consistency
Shift based work, based in high volume environments with mandatory personal protective equipment during all production operation times
q: Proven experience as a Commis 2 or Commis 3 in QSR or high volume restaurants (2 - 4 years minimum)
Proficient with basic health and safety ,Haccap standards (certification preferred)
Understanding of basic preparations and cooking techniques
Ability to work in a fast paced, high volume production environment
Proficient with communication in English and working in a team
Passion for quality and continuous improvements
Able to be a team player for your peers and be the best version of yourself
Obsession with delivering a high level of customer satisfaction
r: li
Assist the Commis 1 and senior chefs in the daily execution of kitchen operations, prep and service work
li
Execute cooking, assembly, and preparations with consistency and efficiency in a fast-paced environment
li
Follow daily production and service plans to ensure the timely delivery of prepared hot meals
li
Align with the fast-paced nature of QSR service while maintaining Calo's quality and nutritional guidelines
li
Ensure precise portioning to align with Calo’s calories and macronutrient guidelines
li
Minimize waste through effective practice of storage, labeling and rotation of ingredients along with smart yield optimization
li
Maintain routine due diligence checks adhering to HACCP standards along with sanitation and safety protocols

d: We are looking for an HR Executive to join our team at Holiday Inn Riyadh Rose Yard. The successful candidate will support the day-to-day Human Resources operations by coordinating HR administration, recruitment, payroll support, colleague engagement, and employee relations while ensuring compliance with IHG standards and Saudi labor regulations. The role works closely with the Human Resources Manager to deliver efficient HR services and create a positive colleague experience.
q: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of Human Resources experience, preferably within the hospitality industry.
Good knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and HR best practices.
Experience with HR Information Systems (HRIS) and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.
r: li
Support daily HR operations, including maintaining colleague records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
li
Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, interview scheduling, onboarding, and new colleague orientation.
li
Assist in preparing employment contracts, HR letters, certificates, and other employee documentation.
li
Support payroll preparation by verifying attendance, leave records, overtime, and payroll inputs.
li
Maintain accurate HR data and ensure timely updates within HR information systems.
li
Assist with employee relations matters and respond to colleague inquiries in a professional and confidential manner.
li
Coordinate colleague engagement activities, recognition programs, and internal events that promote IHG culture and values.
li
Support government-related HR processes and ensure compliance with Saudi labor regulations and company policies.
li
Prepare HR reports, employee statistics, and documentation required for audits and management reporting.
li
Coordinate with department heads to ensure effective communication of HR policies, procedures, and initiatives.
li
Maintain confidentiality of employee information and ensure proper handling of sensitive HR records. Perform other Human Resources-related duties as assigned by the Human Resources Manager.
